description: S001 is a 2026 retrospective report of a UNITA human-rights report. Its headline/lead links more than 90 deaths to June 2025 taxi protests, while a later quoted passage describes July events. It gives no dated gathering, location, attendance or episode boundary; the June attribution does not establish a qualifying June public assembly.
required_followup: If event-level use is required, seek a dated contemporaneous independent account or underlying case list only after fresh scope review; do not infer June protest facts or state-response killings from the retrospective wording.
